Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) using GST-pulldown to identify interacting partners of RUFY3. Acquisition is inferred as DDA based on the use of an LTQ Orbitrap Velos for protein identification from gel-excised bands and eluates. No specific PTM enrichment or labeling strategy was used.

scope: To search for potential interacting partners of RUFY3, GST-pulldown assay followed by identification of proteins using mass spectrometry was done as described.
recombinant GST-RUFY3 and GST-only (as a control) proteins were used as bait proteins and incubated with lysates prepared from HEK293T cells

The coomassie stained protein bands that were specifically present in the GST-RUFY3 sample lane (Sample A: ~250–280 kDa band; Sample B: ~200–250 kDa; Sample C: ~80 kDa; and Sample D: ~16 kDa band) were cut out and submitted to Taplin Mass Spectrometry Facility

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The mass spectrometry analysis was performed on specific protein bands excised from a GST-pulldown assay using GST-RUFY3 as bait, which constitutes an affinity-purified complex.

While the broader paper explores nutrient starvation and other perturbations, the MS data is tied to the genetic/protein bait comparison.
